pride_data.title: Structure of the Hir histone chaperone complex
pride_data.projectDescription: The evolutionarily conserved HIRA/Hir histone chaperone complex and ASF1/Asf1 co-chaperone cooperate for replication-independent chromatin assembly. Here we report the molecular architecture of the Hir complex with Asf1/H3/H4 via single-particle cryo-EM and crosslinking mass spectrometry.
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol: Endogenous yeast Hir complex and bacterial expressed Asf1/H3/H4 were purified. Apo-Hir complex and in vitro reconstituted Hir-Asf1/H3/H4 complex using a gradient sedimentation technique were separately crosslinked with disuccinimidyl dibutyric urea (DSBU).
pride_data.dataProcessingProtocol: MeroX was utilized with default setting with minor edits described in the method section. Prioritization of K-K pair were done when K miscleavages present and localization score ties.

experimentTypes.name: Chemical cross-linking coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

references.referenceLine: Kim HJ, Szurgot MR, van Eeuwen T, Ricketts MD, Basnet P, Zhang AL, Vogt A, Sharmin S, Kaplan CD, Garcia BA, Marmorstein R, Murakami K. Structure of the Hir histone chaperone complex. Mol Cell. 2024 84(14):2601-2617.e12

parsed.evidence_quote: Endogenous yeast Hir complex and bacterial expressed Asf1/H3/H4 were purified.
Apo-Hir complex and in vitro reconstituted Hir-Asf1/H3/H4 complex using a gradient sedimentation technique were separately crosslinked
